A POCKET GUIDE TO THE WILDERNESS

Make yourself at home.

01

Start with a tree.

Hold the left mouse button on a nearby trunk to collect wood. Press E to turn wood into planks, then make sticks and a workbench.

02

Dig a little deeper.

Place your workbench nearby and craft a wooden pickaxe. Stone unlocks better tools and a furnace. Smelt iron with coal, then seek out diamond below.

03

Give the night a doorstop.

Build a shelter before dark. Night brings zombies. Click them to attack; a sword helps. Put down torches, and eat apples or cooked meat with Q.
